name: SDN Record Retention
description: Keeps a rolling window of records on the node (default 72 hours) and deletes what falls out of it. Each target names a standard, its FlatSQL relation, the record's own time column and the sources it covers; records older than now minus window_hours are read with storage.flatsql_query_stream, their content IDs computed as the node computes them (raw CIDv1, sha2-256 of the bare bytes) and deleted with storage.delete. Default target: the weather fields (WXF, by VALID_TIME_MS) of every source. Owner 2026-10-12: a rolling 3-day window on the weather node, configurable, never an archive.

externalInterfaces.description: Reads the expired records (storage.flatsql_query_stream) and deletes them by content ID (storage.delete, the storage_write tier).

inputPorts.description: Cron timer tick (flows/record-retention.flow.json); a direct invoke needs none.

wildcardJustification.detail: One bounded JSON summary of the pass: window, cutoff, records deleted, not held and refused; not a data record.

methods.description: Deletes every configured target's records older than now minus window_hours (plugin config; compiled default 72 h over WXF by VALID_TIME_MS), at most max_deletes a pass.
